definitions.success: Among sensitive prompts actually changed and non-block: all gold characters covered by replacement spans, no exact gold text survives, and no protected rescan finding.
definitions.leakage: Any exact original gold substring survives. Denominators reported for actually sanitized and ALL non-block sensitive prompts (including missed/allow).
definitions.coverage: Ground-truth offsets checked against union of original replacement spans, independent of entity label. Secondary to exact-substring leakage; not encoded/semantic leakage.
definitions.structural: SequenceMatcher ordered unchanged non-sensitive character alignment, placeholder text excluded; not semantic utility.
